note: 1.21.1 made ClickableWidget/ButtonWidget.render (class_339.method_25394) final and moved the override point to the protected method_48579 (renderWidget, implemented by class_4264). Any converted class that still declares/overrides method_25394 fails to load with IncompatibleClassChangeError. This generic rule renames every such declaration to method_48579 and rewrites its invokespecial super call, so the drawing code keeps running. onlyIfExtends is what makes the wildcard safe: 1.21.1 kept method_25394 as the Renderable entry point, and only classes that inherit ClickableWidget are forbidden from overriding it. Cloth Config's list widget inherits class_362 (AbstractParentElement), so renaming it there left thirteen rows that never painted (runs/p210-cloth-config/). Patching with this rule now requires --client-jar/--mappings; without the index an ancestor outside the jar cannot be resolved and the rename is skipped.

methodRenames.evidence: Mod Menu 7.2.2 crashed at the title screen with 'class ModMenuButtonWidget overrides final method class_339.method_25394' and at the mod list with 'class ModsScreen$1 overrides final method class_339.method_25394'; the override point is now class_4264.method_48579 (runs/p92-modmenu/, runs/p94-modmenu-list/). Renaming keeps the drawing code instead of deleting it.

ClickableWidget.method_37020 became final in 1.21.1 and delegates to the protected abstract method_47399; Mod Menu's DescriptionListWidget override caused IncompatibleClassChangeError when opening the mod list (runs/p94-modmenu-list/).
methodRenames.note: Deliberately left without onlyIfExtends: its 8 hits in Cloth Config all kept working, and gating it on class_339 dropped every one of them, which is a regression this round did not earn the right to make. The 25394 rule is the one that had to be gated.
